controller_6m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p291 ('By virtue of Rule 10.07 of the Listing Rules... ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the "First Six-Month Period")'). DATE CORRECTION: 'ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' is an explicit inclusive end ON the anniversary (2026-11-27), so first free = anniversary + 1 = 2026-11-28; candidate's 2026-11-27 made the anniversary itself the free day.

corrections.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(a) disposal undertaking commencing on the prospectus shareholding-disclosure date (inclusive of Listing Date) and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (inclusive end ON the anniversary); first free day = anniversary + 1.

controller_12m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p292 ('(ii) in the period of six months commencing from the expiry of the First Six-Month Period (the "Second Six-Month Period")... would then cease to be a controlling shareholder of our Company for the purpose of the Listing Rules'). Duration wording anchored to the expiry of the First Six-Month Period frees up ON the 12-month anniversary: first_free_day 2027-05-27, last_restricted_day 2027-05-27-1 as recorded. No longer controller lock-up found ('twelve months' hit is the underwriting-agreement 12-month lock-up on p293; other hits are warranties/share schemes).
